# The archived S04 daemon has no SubmitRetryJob method. The new CLI must refuse
# without falling back to its real SubmitJob or running the marker workload.
server start
retry-task retry.json once 1
! skygo run -f retry.json --request-id old-retry
stderr 'unimplemented'
calls SubmitRetryJob 1
calls SubmitJob 0
calls PlanTask 0
calls GetServerInfo 0
! exists first second
# The same old daemon still executes a default task through the legacy method.
retry-task default.json default 0
! skygo --json run -f default.json --request-id old-default --wait
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_FAILED"'
job-id JOB
exists first
! exists second
calls SubmitJob 1
skygo jobs logs $JOB
stdout '^attempt one\n$'
! skygo jobs logs $JOB --attempt 2
stderr 'attempt'
calls StreamJobLogs 1
server stop
! stderr .
